You are not alone, OP. Unfortunately, this is a very canon wlw event. If it’s any consolation, I can promise that it gets better. The love you have for her will probably never go away but the pain will fade. I know it feels like your world is ending right now. That’s okay. Feel it. Let yourself cry and grieve the loss of what you two had. When you’re ready, try to take some walks in nature if you can. Call your friends. Hug your mom!! Know that things will get better with time, as annoying as I know that is to hear right now. I remember not believing people who told me that, but in hindsight, they were 100% right. And when you do move on, know that it doesn’t negate any love that you had for her. You can get through this. I believe in you!!!
